findings.what: (point 5) the change line '+ hypothesis: the orbit avoids -1/3 ... this only matters when 3 is a unit' presents the added condition as a new hypothesis; it is in fact implied by periodicity (−1/3 is never periodic: its orbit is −1/3, 0, 1, 1, … under the anchor's T), so the rewrite is not weaker than the anchor.
